findings.evidence: Semiconj.lean:47-55 already carries the general `[Semiring R] [Module R A] [IsScalarTower R A A] [SMulCommClass R A A]` set; Mathlib states the analogous `Polynomial.smeval_commute`/`smeval_commute_left` at exactly that level (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Smeval.lean:286-295). The proofs at Semiconj.lean:78-91 use only `add_mul`, `mul_add`, `succ_nsmul`, `abel`, `pow_succ`.
findings.fix: State them as `theorem smeval_mul_pow_eq {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (p : R[X]) {a x c : A} (h : a * x = x * (a + c)) (hc : Commute c x) (n : ℕ)` with the section instances `[Module R A] [IsScalarTower R A A] [SMulCommClass R A A]`, matching `SemiconjBy.smeval_right`; the `descPochhammer ℤ m` call sites at lines 149 and 187 are unchanged since those ℤ instances are already inferred. Additionally, `mul_pow_eq_pow_mul_add_nsmul` and `smeval_mul_pow_eq` never use subtraction, so they belong in a `Semiring A` section, with `[Ring A]` kept only for the `sub` variants.
findings.issue: `Polynomial.smeval_mul_pow_eq` (line 112) and `pow_mul_smeval_eq` (line 123) fix `p : Polynomial ℤ`, but neither proof uses ℤ: both just feed a `SemiconjBy` into `smeval_right`, which is stated for an arbitrary coefficient semiring. The ℤ specialization is invisible to any user with rational- or R-coefficient polynomials.

findings.evidence: `ringChoose_mul_pow_eq m hsub hc n : Ring.choose (a - n•c) m * x ^ n = x ^ n * Ring.choose ((a - n•c) + n•c) m`, and `sub_add_cancel` turns the argument into `a`, which is the statement at line 170 reversed. The file already uses this exact reduction for the smeval pair at lines 105-106.
findings.fix: Extract the shift hypothesis currently inlined at lines 97-104 as a private lemma `hsub : (a - n • c) * x = x * ((a - n • c) + c)`, then prove `pow_mul_ringChoose_eq` as `simpa using (ringChoose_mul_pow_eq m hsub hc n).symm`, using `sub_add_cancel` to rewrite `(a - n • c) + n • c` to `a`.
findings.issue: `pow_mul_ringChoose_eq` re-runs the entire `Ring.descPochhammer_eq_factorial_smul_choose` / `nsmul_right_injective` argument already carried out in `ringChoose_mul_pow_eq` (lines 138-164), even though it is a direct corollary of it.

summary: The polynomial-level reordering lemmas are stated only for ℤ coefficients although their proofs and the file's own general mechanism (`SemiconjBy.smeval_right`) work over any coefficient semiring, and the left-hand binomial variant repeats a factorial-cancellation proof that follows in two lines from the right-hand one.
